title: Railway Operations & Logistics

canonicalTerminology.definition: Train formation is the planned assembly and ordering of vehicles into a train subject to applicable compatibility, operational and safety constraints.

claims.text: Railway logistics coordinates capacity, train planning, terminal activity, wagon or unit flow and information so transport demand can be converted into executable rail movements.
claims.applicabilityNote: Educational canonical statement. Apply current infrastructure-manager rules and approved operating procedures for real train formation or movement decisions.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show freight movement from demand to train execution and delivery.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent train-formation limits, route restrictions or operational thresholds.
Do not present training logistics flows as approved operating instructions.
